title: Symbol at a tape position
statement: For a list of segments and an index $s$, the symbol at the left boundary is absent when $s=0$ and otherwise is true. At a cell with index $c$, it is the Boolean at index $c$ in the selected segment's list, if present. At the right boundary, it is false when a next segment exists and is absent otherwise.
